# macMAKE Release Notes Template

## Corresponding Source for Open-Source Components

This binary distribution bundles or invokes open-source components covered by the GNU General Public License (GPLv3). In accordance with their respective licenses, the corresponding source archives, patches, build scripts, and configuration manifests are available at:

- **Source Repository:** [mplsllc/macmake-gpl](https://github.com/mplsllc/macmake-gpl)
- **Source Release:** [`v0.1.0-toolchain-sources`](https://github.com/mplsllc/macmake-gpl/releases/tag/v0.1.0-toolchain-sources)
- **Distribution Manifest:** [`corresponding-source-manifest.json`](https://github.com/mplsllc/macmake-gpl/blob/main/corresponding-source-manifest.json)
